> > `crates/logic/src/reason/value.rs:341-350` > **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win** > > **Preserve lexical admission for `owl:rational` and `owl:real`.** > > `LiteralValue::from_parts` sends these datatypes to `rational` with the original lexical form, but `rational` still trims it. This can admit whitespace-wrapped values such as `" 1/2 "` and `" 0.5\u{a0}"`. Remove the trim so the parser receives the source lexical form. > >
> 🐛 Suggested fix > > ```diff > - let lexical = lexical.trim(); > if lexical.contains('/') { > ``` > >
